query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Migrate active Todoist projects, sections, tasks, subtasks, labels, due dates, priorities, durations, and assignment metadata into a private ClickUp Space, then verify the migration without modifying Todoist source data.
query_ground_truth.intent: Provision a new private Space in ClickUp to serve as the destination for the migration.

requirement_groups.purpose: configure the ClickUp Space as private

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Resolve the correct destination team context using CLICKUP_GET_AUTHORIZED_TEAMS_WORKSPACES (match the provided workspace label, capture teams[].id as team_id; if avoiding duplicate names, scan existing spaces via CLICKUP_GET_SPACES).

[Required] [Step]: Create the space using CLICKUP_CREATE_SPACE (team_id + space title + multiple_assignees); store the returned id as space_id and omit features/privacy unless supplying a complete nested features object.

[Optional (for verification/duplicate-check)] [Next Step]: Confirm the space exists and is visible using CLICKUP_GET_SPACE (space_id) and/or CLICKUP_GET_SPACES (ensure it appears under the expected team).

[Optional (if privacy/features must be configured)] [Next Step]: Apply privacy/feature changes after creation using CLICKUP_UPDATE_SPACE (prefer create-then-update; when modifying features, send the full nested features payload).

[Required] [Fallback (if CLICKUP_CREATE_SPACE is blocked by permissions/plan limits or validation)]: Inspect entitlements using CLICKUP_GET_WORKSPACE_PLAN and remediate access using CLICKUP_UPDATE_WORKSPACE_ACL when applicable; otherwise retry CLICKUP_CREATE_SPACE with only required fields (omit feature-related inputs).
known_pitfalls: [CLICKUP_GET_AUTHORIZED_TEAMS_WORKSPACES] Responses can be large/truncated; reliably extract teams[].id and keep IDs as strings.
[CLICKUP_CREATE_SPACE] 400 invalid request if required fields are omitted (commonly team_id, name, multiple_assignees).
[CLICKUP_CREATE_SPACE] 400 validation when sending partial/flattened feature flags (e.g., features__*); omit features on create or provide a complete nested features object.
[CLICKUP_CREATE_SPACE] 401/403 (e.g., ACCESS_009) indicates permission gating; PAYWALL_004 can indicate plan limits blocking new spaces.

[CLICKUP_CREATE_SPACE] Duplicate-name creation can fail with a validation error indicating the space name already exists; handle by locating the existing space via CLICKUP_GET_SPACES instead of repeated creates.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: ClickUp unifies tasks, docs, goals, and chat in a single platform, allowing teams to plan, organize, and collaborate across projects with customizable workflows
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=clickup. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="clickup") to create a connection BEFORE executing any clickup tools.

CLICKUP_CREATE_SPACE.description: Creates a new ClickUp Space within a specified Workspace, allowing feature configuration which defaults to Workspace settings if unspecified.

team_id.description: Numeric ID of the Workspace (Team) for the new Space.

multiple_assignees.description: Enable/disable multiple assignees for tasks in this Space.

features__tags__enabled.description: Enable/disable Tags. Defaults to Workspace setting if `None`.

features__checklists__enabled.description: Enable/disable Checklists. Defaults to Workspace setting if `None`.

features__due__dates__enabled.description: Enable/disable Due Dates. Defaults to Workspace setting if `None`.

features__portfolios__enabled.description: Enable/disable Portfolios. Defaults to Workspace setting if `None`.

features__custom__fields__enabled.description: Enable/disable Custom Fields. Defaults to Workspace setting if `None`.

features__due__dates__start__date.description: Enable/disable Start Date for Due Dates (if Due Dates enabled). Defaults to Workspace setting if `None`.

features__time__tracking__enabled.description: Enable/disable Time Tracking. Defaults to Workspace setting if `None`.

features__time__estimates__enabled.description: Enable/disable Time Estimates. Defaults to Workspace setting if `None`.

features__dependency__warning__enabled.description: Enable/disable Dependency Warning (shows conflict warnings). Defaults to Workspace setting if `None`.

features__remap__dependencies__enabled.description: Enable/disable Remap Dependencies (auto-adjusts task dates). Defaults to Workspace setting if `None`.

features__due__dates__remap__due__dates.description: Enable/disable subtask due date remapping (if Due Dates enabled). Defaults to Workspace setting if `None`.

features__due__dates__remap__closed__due.description: Enable/disable closed subtask due date remapping (if Due Dates & subtask remapping enabled). Defaults to Workspace setting if `None`.

CLICKUP_GET_AUTHORIZED_TEAMS_WORKSPACES.description: Retrieves a list of Workspaces (Teams) the authenticated user can access.

CLICKUP_UPDATE_SPACE.description: Updates an existing ClickUp Space, allowing modification of its name, color, privacy, and feature settings (ClickApps).

name.description: The new name for the Space.

color.description: The new color for the Space, in hexadecimal format.

private.description: Whether the Space should be private.

space_id.description: The ID of the Space to update.

admin_can_manage.description: Whether admins can manage this private Space. This is an Enterprise Plan feature. Must be omitted for non-Enterprise workspaces.

multiple_assignees.description: Whether tasks in this Space can have multiple assignees.

features__tags__enabled.description: Enable or disable the Tags ClickApp. When any feature parameter is provided, all feature keys must be included (due_dates, time_estimates, time_tracking, remap_dependencies, custom_fields, dependency_warning, tags, checklists, portfolios).

features__due_dates__enabled.description: Enable or disable the Due Dates ClickApp.

features__checklists__enabled.description: Enable or disable the Checklists ClickApp.

features__portfolios__enabled.description: Enable or disable the Portfolios ClickApp.

features__due_dates__start_date.description: Enable or disable Start Dates for the Due Dates ClickApp.

features__custom_fields__enabled.description: Enable or disable the Custom Fields ClickApp.

features__time_tracking__enabled.description: Enable or disable the Time Tracking ClickApp.

features__time_estimates__enabled.description: Enable or disable the Time Estimates ClickApp.

features__due_dates__remap_due_dates.description: Enable or disable remapping of due dates for the Due Dates ClickApp.

features__dependency_warning__enabled.description: Enable or disable Dependency Warning for the Task Dependencies ClickApp.

features__remap_dependencies__enabled.description: Enable or disable Remap Dependencies for the Task Dependencies ClickApp.

features__due_dates__remap_closed_due_da.description: Enable or disable remapping of closed due dates for the Due Dates ClickApp.
